Automatic Downloads system behavior vs zh-Hans listing copy — two different jobs

Teams assume download-sync features in the app cover storefront language. iOS Settings and App Store Connect actually separate cross-device download behavior from product-page copy:

  • Settings → App Store → Automatic Downloads — on iPhone and iPad, the primary surface listing Automatic Downloads toggles. On some devices the path is Settings → Media & Purchases → Automatic Downloads. Your listing may show this screen on screenshots; teaching buyers where sync toggles live is listing copy, not engineering work.
  • Apps toggle — automatically downloads new app purchases to every device signed into the same Apple ID. zh-Hans Settings often labels this 自动下载 App. Does not generate Chinese listing text by itself.
  • App Updates toggle — automatically downloads app updates to all signed-in devices. zh-Hans UI uses 自动下载更新. Distinct from the Apps toggle in marketing scope when your gallery shows both switches separately.
  • Books/Audiobooks, Music, TV & Movies toggles — extend automatic download sync to other media categories under the same Automatic Downloads section. zh-Hans may use 自动下载图书, 自动下载音乐, or category-specific labels. Listing copy should name only the toggles your screenshots actually show.
  • Same Apple ID requirement — Automatic Downloads syncs across devices signed into one Apple ID. Your description may mention multi-device convenience; account plumbing is platform behavior — distinct from zh-Hans caption lines.
  • Pricing and Availability → China — makes the app downloadable on the China App Store. Separate from language rows.
  • App Store tab → Chinese (Simplified) localization — independent row for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text, screenshots, and caption lines. Empty or English here means China buyers see English fallback regardless of download-sync features in the binary.

A working Automatic Downloads story on device and a localized China listing are both required when you sell on the China storefront — neither replaces the other.

Automatic Downloads is not Offload Unused Apps, Family Sharing, Ask to Buy, or iCloud Backup

Device-management and store-adjacent apps blur several Apple surfaces indie teams conflate. AppLocale covers listing metadata only — Automatic Downloads marketing on the product page:

  • Automatic Downloads (this page) — Settings → App Store or Media & Purchases, Apps / App Updates / Books / Music / TV & Movies sync toggles, cross-device purchase and update download, 自动下载, 自动下载 App, 自动下载更新.
  • Offload Unused Apps (different) — Settings → General → iPhone Storage, automatic app binary removal while keeping data — 卸载未使用的 App. See Offload Unused Apps listing guide — storage management, not download sync.
  • Family Sharing hub (different) — shared purchases, family plans, Share with Family badges — 家人共享. See Family Sharing listing guide — shared access pool, not per-device download toggles.
  • Ask to Buy (different) — parental purchase approval when a child requests a download — 购买前询问. See Ask to Buy listing guide — approval gate, not automatic sync.
  • iCloud Backup (different) — full-device backup under Settings → iCloud → iCloud Backup — 自动备份. See iCloud Backup listing guide — device restore snapshot, not App Store purchase sync.
  • Automatic Ear Detection or Automatic Switching (different) — AirPods wear detection and cross-device audio handoff under Bluetooth settings — 自动检测佩戴, 自动切换. Not App Store Automatic Downloads despite similar "Automatic" naming.

Your gallery may show App Store settings and iCloud settings in adjacent frames. Listing copy should name the correct surface per frame — an Automatic Downloads toggle with 自动下载 App is not an iPhone Storage offload screen, not a Family Sharing invite sheet, not an Ask to Buy approval mockup, and not an iCloud Backup progress bar unless that is what the screenshot shows.

Automatic Downloads-specific listing copy — what translates differently

App Store settings listings use vocabulary general utility guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers describe Apple's download-sync features — not a literal paste of US marketing:

Automatic Downloads phrasing

US pages use "Automatic Downloads", "Automatically download apps to all your devices", or "Keep every device in sync." Apple's Simplified Chinese Settings vocabulary uses 自动下载 for the section header. AppLocale aligns phrasing with Apple's consumer-facing terms while keeping your app's voice — not inventing sync capabilities your app does not support.

Apps vs App Updates toggles

Gallery frames differ — a toggle for new app purchases versus a toggle for app updates. 自动下载 App maps to the Apps switch. 自动下载更新 maps to App Updates. Do not collapse both into one generic 自动下载 string when your gallery shows both toggles on the same screen.

Books, Music, and TV & Movies toggles

When your English listing markets media-category sync beyond apps, zh-Hans overlays may use 自动下载图书, 自动下载音乐, or category labels matching Apple's Settings UI — honest scope when your screenshots show those toggles, not when your hero is app download sync alone.

App Store vs Media & Purchases path

iPhone and iPad often show Settings → App Store → Automatic Downloads. Some devices route through Settings → Media & Purchases → Automatic Downloads. zh-Hans caption lines should match the path your screenshot actually shows — 设置 → App Store → 自动下载 or the Media & Purchases equivalent.

Cross-device sync benefit callouts

Marketing frames often highlight "Buy once, available everywhere" or "Updates install on every device." zh-Hans benefit lines may use 跨设备同步 or 所有设备自动下载 when your English listing already claims multi-device convenience — distinct from iCloud Backup restore language.

Subtitle and keyword packing

The 30-character subtitle and 100-character keyword field need download-sync search terms Chinese buyers type — see Simplified Chinese keywords & subtitle for field mechanics. Terms like 自动下载, 自动下载 App, and 自动下载更新 each signal different intent from 卸载未使用的 App storage keywords or 家人共享 family-plan keywords.

FAQ

What is Automatic Downloads and where do buyers find it?

Automatic Downloads is under Settings → App Store (or Settings → Media & Purchases → Automatic Downloads on some devices). Toggles for Apps, App Updates, and optionally Books, Music, and TV & Movies sync new purchases and updates to every device on the same Apple ID. Simplified Chinese Settings labels the section 自动下载 with 自动下载 App and 自动下载更新 per toggle.

Does enabling Automatic Downloads auto-translate my China listing?

No. The toggles control cross-device download sync — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback.

How is Automatic Downloads different from Offload Unused Apps?

Offload Unused Apps removes unused app binaries under Settings → General → iPhone Storage — 卸载未使用的 App. Automatic Downloads syncs new purchases and updates under Settings → App Store — 自动下载 App and 自动下载更新. See our Offload Unused Apps listing guide for storage scope.

How is Automatic Downloads different from Family Sharing or Ask to Buy?

Family Sharing covers shared purchases and family plans — 家人共享. Ask to Buy covers parental purchase approval — 购买前询问. Automatic Downloads covers per-device download sync toggles — 自动下载. See our Family Sharing listing guide and Ask to Buy listing guide for those scopes.

How is Automatic Downloads different from iCloud Backup?

iCloud Backup saves a full-device snapshot for restore — 自动备份. Automatic Downloads pulls new App Store purchases and updates to each signed-in device — 自动下载. See our iCloud Backup listing guide for backup scope.

Reply from the email address on your Stripe receipt — we deliver to that Stripe email within 24 hours.

We do not guarantee keyword position, chart rank, or install growth. Complete zh-Hans metadata helps sync-aware buyers who already found your page understand download-sync value in their language.
